facts.fact: President Boko, opening the 51st Botswana Police Senior Officers Annual Conference on 2025-05-06, said police officers currently spent 60 percent of their time behind the desk doing paperwork, time technology and artificial intelligence could return to field work; he named no record or system, and the document does not say the paperwork is the occurrence book or case file.

systems.tiers: cameras installed at strategic locations, as the president states it

note: The one fact is the president's general statement about paperwork; whether it bears on station records is the parent's to decide. Drones and artificial intelligence are proposals, not systems in use.
